def transform(grid):
    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v != 0]
    if not cells:
        return []
    r0 = min(r for r, c in cells)
    r1 = max(r for r, c in cells)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in cells)
    c1 = max(c for r, c in cells)
    h, w = r1 - r0 + 1, c1 - c0 + 1
    return [grid[r][c0:c0 + w // 2] for r in range(r0, r0 + h // 2)]
